calculation_handling.description: If main walls of lawfully existing buildings (or of one lawfully existing building) are closer together than the required minimum separation, the lawful separation is their minimum.
calculation_handling.gaps: The clause sets the minimum to the as-built separation but names no date, so it cannot be written with existing(variable; date); keyed UNUSUAL (conservative) rather than as a LIMIT.

units.disclosure: Existing buildings whose walls are lawfully closer together than today's rules allow keep that separation; we cannot check existing wall positions.

calculation_handling.description: An addition to a lawfully existing building relying on 10.60.40.81(1) must meet the main wall separation in 10.60.40.80(1) and (2) or be authorized by a minor variance.

units.disclosure: Additions to such a building must meet current wall separation rules or get a minor variance.

10.60.40.81(1).explanation: In the RT zone, if existing buildings were lawfully built with walls closer together than today's minimum, that existing distance is their minimum.

10.60.40.81(2).explanation: Additions to such a building must meet the current wall separation rules or be approved by a minor variance.
